<?php
/**
 * ML Inference Server - Cross-service authentication module
 * Handles model loading and prediction requests from authenticated services
 */

class TokenStore {
    private string $tokenDir;
    
    public function __construct(string $baseDir = '/var/ml-server/tokens') {
        $this->tokenDir = $baseDir;
    }
    
    public function getTokenPath(string $serviceId): ?string {
        $sanitized = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $serviceId);
        // Reject if sanitization altered the input or produced an empty name,
        // preventing access to unintended files like '/.token'.
        if ($sanitized === '' || $sanitized !== $serviceId) {
            return null;
        }
        return $this->tokenDir . '/' . $sanitized . '.token';
    }
    
    public function readToken(string $path): ?string {
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            return null;
        }
        return trim(file_get_contents($path));
    }
}

class AuthValidator {
    private TokenStore $store;
    private array $revokedTokens = [];
    
    public function __construct(TokenStore $store) {
        $this->store = $store;
        $this->loadRevocationList();
    }
    
    private function loadRevocationList(): void {
        $revPath = '/var/ml-server/revoked.json';
        if (file_exists($revPath)) {
            $data = json_decode(file_get_contents($revPath), true);
            $this->revokedTokens = $data['revoked'] ?? [];
        }
    }
    
    public function validateServiceAuth(string $serviceId, string $presentedToken): bool {
        $tokenPath = $this->store->getTokenPath($serviceId);
        if ($tokenPath === null) {
            error_log("Auth failed: invalid service id: $serviceId");
            return false;
        }
        
        // Atomically read the token once for all checks
        $storedToken = $this->store->readToken($tokenPath);
        if ($storedToken === null) {
            error_log("Auth failed: token file not accessible for service: $serviceId");
            return false;
        }
        
        // Verify the token is not in revocation list
        if (in_array($storedToken, $this->revokedTokens, true)) {
            error_log("Auth failed: token revoked for service: $serviceId");
            return false;
        }
        
        // Constant-time comparison of presented token against stored token
        return hash_equals($storedToken, $presentedToken);
    }
}

class ModelRegistry {
    private string $modelDir;
    
    public function __construct(string $dir = '/var/ml-server/models') {
        $this->modelDir = $dir;
    }
    
    public function loadModel(string $modelName): ?array {
        $safe = preg_replace('/[^a-zA-Z0-9_-]/', '', $modelName);
        // Reject if sanitization altered the input or produced an empty name,
        // preventing access to unintended files like '/.json'.
        if ($safe === '' || $safe !== $modelName) {
            return null;
        }
        $path = $this->modelDir . '/' . $safe . '.json';
        if (!file_exists($path)) {
            return null;
        }
        return json_decode(file_get_contents($path), true);
    }
    
    public function predict(array $model, array $features): array {
        // Simple linear model inference
        $weights = $model['weights'] ?? [];
        $bias = $model['bias'] ?? 0.0;
        $score = $bias;
        foreach ($features as $i => $val) {
            $score += ($weights[$i] ?? 0.0) * floatval($val);
        }
        return [
            'prediction' => $score > 0.5 ? 1 : 0,
            'confidence' => min(1.0, max(0.0, $score)),
            'model_version' => $model['version'] ?? 'unknown'
        ];
    }
}

class InferenceServer {
    private AuthValidator $auth;
    private ModelRegistry $models;
    
    public function __construct() {
        $store = new TokenStore();
        $this->auth = new AuthValidator($store);
        $this->models = new ModelRegistry();
    }
    
    public function handleRequest(array $request): array {
        $serviceId = $request['service_id'] ?? '';
        $token = $request['auth_token'] ?? '';
        $modelName = $request['model'] ?? '';
        $features = $request['features'] ?? [];
        
        if (empty($serviceId) || empty($token) || empty($modelName)) {
            return ['error' => 'Missing required fields', 'code' => 400];
        }
        
        if (!$this->auth->validateServiceAuth($serviceId, $token)) {
            return ['error' => 'Authentication failed', 'code' => 401];
        }
        
        $model = $this->models->loadModel($modelName);
        if ($model === null) {
            return ['error' => 'Model not found', 'code' => 404];
        }
        
        if (!is_array($features) || empty($features)) {
            return ['error' => 'Invalid features', 'code' => 422];
        }
        
        $result = $this->models->predict($model, $features);
        $result['service'] = $serviceId;
        $result['timestamp'] = time();
        return $result;
    }
}

// Entry point
$input = json_decode(file_get_contents('php://input'), true);
if ($input === null) {
    http_response_code(400);
    echo json_encode(['error' => 'Invalid JSON']);
    exit;
}

$server = new InferenceServer();
$response = $server->handleRequest($input);

if (isset($response['code'])) {
    http_response_code($response['code']);
    unset($response['code']);
}

header('Content-Type: application/json');
echo json_encode($response);
